interval_years.quote: Every registration issued to a dispensing ophthalmic business, contact lens dispenser, and spectacle lens dispenser shall expire 24 months after the initial date of issuance or renewal.

exists.quote: "Board" means the California State Board of Optometry.

national_certification.value: American Board of Opticianry (ABO); National Committee of Contact Lens Examiners (NCCLE)
national_certification.quote: the registry examination of the American Board of Opticianry or any successor agency to that board

regulatory_model.quote: An individual shall not fit and adjust spectacle lenses unless either of the following applies: (1) The individual is a duly registered spectacle lens dispenser as provided in Section 2559.2.

credential_type.quote: "Dispensing optician," "registered dispensing optician," and "registrant" mean any of the following individuals that are registered with the board

is_mandatory.quote: An individual shall not fit and adjust spectacle lenses unless either of the following applies: (1) The individual is a duly registered spectacle lens dispenser as provided in Section 2559.2.

title_protection.quote: Any person who holds himself out as a "dispensing optician" or "registered dispensing optician" or who uses any other term or letters indicating or implying that he is registered and holds a certificate under the terms of this law without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked certificate, as provided in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: An individual shall not fit and adjust spectacle lenses unless either of the following applies: (1) The individual is a duly registered spectacle lens dispenser as provided in Section 2559.2.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating, attempting to violate, conspiring to violate, or assisting in violation of any provision of this chapter or board regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating, attempting to violate, conspiring to violate, or directly or indirectly assisting in or abetting the violation of any provision of this chapter or any of the rules and regulations adopted by the board pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in optician practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Two or more negligent acts or omissions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated negligent acts. To be repeated, there must be two or more negligent acts or omissions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the performance of optician duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of fraud, misrepresentation, or any act involving dishonesty or corruption substantially related to optician qualifications, functions, or duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of fraud, misrepresentation, or any act involving dishonesty or corruption that is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a registered optician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any action or conduct that would have warranted the denial of a registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action or conduct that would have warranted the denial of a registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of advertising relating to opticianry that violates statutory prohibitions on false or misleading advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of advertising relating to opticianry that violates Section 651 or 17500.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial, revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action against a health care professional license by another state, territory, governmental agency, or California licensing board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Denial of licensure, revocation, suspension, restriction, or any other disciplinary action against a health care professional license, registration, or permit by another state or territory of the United States, by any other governmental agency, or by another California health care professional licensing board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring registration by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring the registrant's registration by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with the application for issuance of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with the application for issuance of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a registered dispensing optician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a registered dispensing optician, in which event the record of the conviction shall be conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Self-administering controlled substances or using dangerous drugs or alcohol to the extent dangerous or injurious to the registrant or others, or impairing ability to safely practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering to oneself any controlled substance or using any of the dangerous drugs specified in Section 4022, or using alcoholic beverages to the extent, or in a manner, as to be dangerous or injurious to the person applying for a license or holding a registration under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing or soliciting a sexually related crime, sexual abuse, misconduct, or relations with a patient substantially related to optician qualifications.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing or soliciting an act punishable as a sexually related crime, if that act or solicitation is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of an optician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain adequate and accurate records relating to the provision of services to patients.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to maintain adequate and accurate records relating to the provision of services to one's patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or holding oneself out as able to perform professional services beyond the scope of the optician license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, or holding oneself out as being able to perform, or offering to perform, any professional services beyond the scope of the license authorized by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing functions defined in the chapter without a valid, unrevoked, unexpired registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of functions defined in this chapter without a valid, unrevoked, unexpired registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly employing any suspended or unregistered individual to perform work requiring an optician registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employing, directly or indirectly, of any suspended or unregistered individual to perform any work for which an optician registration is required.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use the registrant's registration for any purpose.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting another person to use the registration for any purpose.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altering with fraudulent intent a registration issued by the board, or using a fraudulently altered license, permit, certification, or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altering with fraudulent intent a registration issued by the board, or using a fraudulently altered license, permit, certification, or any registration issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow board infection control guidelines, thereby risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except for good cause, the knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines of the board, thereby risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases from optician to patient, from patient to patient, or from patient to optician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing ophthalmic lenses without a current prescription.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing ophthalmic lenses without a current prescription.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Individuals, corporations, and firms shall make application for registration and shall not engage in that business defined in Section 2564.90 before being issued a certificate of registration.

definition_quote.value: "Fit" and "fitting" mean doing any of the following acts, either singly or in combination with others, before the act of adjusting: designing, taking measurements to determine the size, shape, or specifications, and replacing the prescribed optical aids, pursuant and incidental to the filling of any prescription for lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, contact lens, plano contact lens, and other ophthalmic devices as specified in Section 2541.
definition_quote.quote: "Fit" and "fitting" mean doing any of the following acts, either singly or in combination with others, before the act of adjusting: designing, taking measurements to determine the size, shape, or specifications, and replacing the prescribed optical aids, pursuant and incidental to the filling of any prescription for lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, contact lens, plano contact lens, and other ophthalmic devices as specified in Section 2541.

methods_authorized.quote: "Adjust" and "adjusting" includes the following acts, either singly or in combination with others: adapting or manipulation of the ophthalmic device to fit the face of the consumer, pursuant and incidental to the filling of any prescription for lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, contact lens, plano contact lens, and other ophthalmic devices

license_tier_structure.quote: "Dispensing optician," "registered dispensing optician," and "registrant" mean any of the following individuals that are registered with the board: (1) "Spectacle lens dispenser" ... (2) "Contact lens dispenser" ... (3) "Nonresident ophthalmic lens dispenser" ... (4) "Registered dispensing ophthalmic business"

contact_lens_scope_included.quote: An individual shall not fit and adjust contact lenses, including plano contact lenses unless either of the following applies: (a) The individual is a duly registered contact lens dispenser as provided in Section 2561.

duplicate_without_prescription_allowed.quote: it is unlawful for a registered dispensing optician or a person who engages in the business of, or holds himself or herself out to be, a dispensing optician to do any of the following: to advertise the furnishing of, or to furnish, the services of an optometrist or a physician and surgeon, to directly employ an optometrist or physician and surgeon for the purpose of any examination or treatment of the eyes, or to duplicate or change lenses without a prescription or order from a person duly licensed to issue the same.

written_prescription_required.quote: A registered dispensing optician shall not dispense a spectacle lens or contact lens prescription unless the prescription meets the requirements of Section 2541.1 or 2541.2, as applicable.

prescription_expiration_enforced.quote: A registered dispensing optician shall not dispense a spectacle lens prescription after the expiration date of the prescription unless so authorized pursuant to subdivision (e) of Section 2541.1.

contact_lens_followup_required.quote: Upon satisfactory completion of the fitting of contact lenses, but in no event more than 60 days after receipt of the prescription, a registered contact lens dispenser shall direct the person named in the prescription to return to the prescribing physician and surgeon or optometrist for an evaluation.

impact_resistant_lens_required.quote: No person, company, or association shall sell or barter or offer to sell or barter any medical degree, podiatric degree, or osteopathic degree

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_limit.quote: In no event shall a registered contact lens dispenser supervise more than three unregistered individuals.

unlicensed_assistant_tasks_permitted.quote: The unregistered individual may perform any of the following: (1) Fitting and adjusting of spectacle lenses under the direct responsibility and supervision of a duly registered spectacle lens dispenser pursuant to Section 2559.1.

supervisor_physical_presence_required.quote: A supervising registered spectacle lens dispenser shall be physically present on the registered premises when an unregistered individual fits and adjusts spectacle lenses.

licensed_optician_on_premises_required.quote: A supervising registered spectacle lens dispenser shall be physically present on the registered premises when an unregistered individual fits and adjusts spectacle lenses.

optical_establishment_permit_required.quote: Individuals, corporations, and firms shall make application for registration and shall not engage in that business defined in Section 2564.90 before being issued a certificate of registration.

branch_office_limit_or_permit.quote: Separate applications shall be made for each place of business and each application shall be accompanied by the application fee prescribed by Section 2565.

colocation_with_prescriber_restrictions.quote: All licensed optometrists and registered dispensing opticians who are in a colocated setting shall report the business relationship to the California State Board of Optometry, as determined by the board.

physician_ownership_interest_prohibited.quote: the board shall deny any application for registration under this chapter if any person licensed as a physician and surgeon, for whom the applicant, in accordance with Section 2564.90, proposes to fill any prescription, has any proprietary interest, or has designated or arranged for any other person to have any proprietary interest in or with the applicant.

advertising_eye_exam_claim_prohibited.quote: it is unlawful for a registered dispensing optician or a person who engages in the business of, or holds himself or herself out to be, a dispensing optician to do any of the following: to advertise the furnishing of, or to furnish, the services of an optometrist or a physician and surgeon

fee_splitting_with_prescriber_prohibited.quote: No person licensed under Chapter 5 (commencing with Section 2000) of this division may have any membership, proprietary interest or coownership in any form in or with any person licensed under Chapter 5.5 (commencing with Section 2550) of this division to whom patients, clients or customers are referred or any profit-sharing arrangements.

nonresident_remote_dispenser_registratio.quote: A person or entity located outside California shall not ship, mail, furnish, or deliver in any manner, ophthalmic lenses at retail to a patient at a California address unless the person is registered with the California State Board of Optometry.

scope_excludes_eye_examination_and_presc.quote: it is unlawful for a registered dispensing optician or a person who engages in the business of, or holds himself or herself out to be, a dispensing optician to do any of the following: to advertise the furnishing of, or to furnish, the services of an optometrist or a physician and surgeon, to directly employ an optometrist or physician and surgeon for the purpose of any examination or treatment of the eyes

ready_made_nonprescription_eyewear_exemp.quote: This chapter does not prohibit the sale of goggles, sun glasses, colored glasses, or occupational protective eye devices if they do not have refractive values nor do the provisions of this chapter prohibit the sale of complete ready-to-wear eyeglasses as merchandise.
